settings.heading: By invitation.
settings.body: Pantao opens its doors once a year. Submit your application below — each is read by hand. Successful applicants receive correspondence within forty-eight hours, and are notified before the public when the doors open.
settings.fine_print: By applying you agree to receive correspondence from Pantao. We do not sell your information.
settings.accepted_heading: Thank you. Your application is with us.
settings.accepted_body:
Each application is read by hand. If you are admitted, you will receive correspondence at your address within forty-eight hours, with a note on what follows.

If you do not hear from us in that time, the doors are closed for this edition. We hold your name and may write again.
